description: This file contains cryptographic prime number generation and primality testing functions, including Miller-Rabin tests, trial division, and prime candidate generation, specifically for RSA and DH key generation within the BoringSSL library.

classes.name: BN_MILLER_RABIN
classes.description: Structure for holding Miller-Rabin test state during primality testing.

classes.name: BN_GENCB
classes.description: Callback structure for prime generation progress and events.

methods.name: BN_prime_checks_for_size
methods.description: Returns the number of Miller-Rabin iterations needed for a given prime size in bits.

methods.name: num_trial_division_primes
methods.description: Determines how many small primes to test with trial division based on the size of the number.

methods.name: probable_prime
methods.description: Generates a probable prime candidate of specified bit length, avoiding obvious composites.

methods.name: probable_prime_dh
methods.description: Generates a probable prime candidate for Diffie-Hellman parameters with specific constraints.

methods.name: probable_prime_dh_safe
methods.description: Generates a probable safe prime candidate for Diffie-Hellman parameters.
